summary: публичное акционерное общество "Нефтяная компания "Роснефть" (Rosneft PJSC) is identifier-confirmed via LEI 253400JT3MQWNDKMJE44 and INN 1027700043502, registered in Russia (RU). Ownership and control indicators from Wikidata (indicative only) point to the Federal Agency for State Property Management and Rosneftegaz as parent entities, with the Government of Russia noted as a controlling owner; JSC "ROSNEFTEGAZ" and BP RUSSIAN INVESTMENTS LIMITED are also reported as shareholders per OpenSanctions, and Igor Sechin has held the role of chief executive officer since 2012-06-09 per OpenSanctions, with Mohammed Saleh Al Sada reported as chairperson from 2023-07-01 per Wikidata. OpenSanctions lists the entity as sanctioned, debarred from public contracts, and subject to export-control restrictions (all high confidence), and flags it for trade risk (medium confidence); additionally, 11 sanctioned securities mapped to this entity are subject to sanctions and investment bans across multiple jurisdictions including Australia, Canada, the EU, the UK, and the US per OpenSanctions. The entity's ownership structure carries a medium-confidence signal of complex ownership layers (three or more corporate layers per OpenSanctions), and numerous subsidiaries and related parties — including Rosneft Deutschland GmbH, РН-Капитал, ДИНК-ИНВЕСТ, РН-ТРЕЙД, РН-РАЗВЕДКА И ДОБЫЧА, Ruhr Oel GmbH, Nizhnevartovskaya GRES, LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY RN KRASNODARNEFTEGAZ, NAYARA ENERGY LIMITED, and others — are themselves flagged as sanctioned, debarred, export-controlled, or linked to sanctioned parties per OpenSanctions and OpenAleph. Material limitations include: Wikirate could not be queried due to a source API schema error, so data from that source is absent; and OpenSanctions data is licensed CC-BY-NC-4.0, precluding commercial re-use.

claims.text: публичное акционерное общество "Нефтяная компания "Роснефть" is identifier-confirmed via LEI 253400JT3MQWNDKMJE44 and INN 1027700043502, registered in Russia (RU).
Wikidata (indicative only) records the Federal Agency for State Property Management and Rosneftegaz as parent entities, and the Government of Russia as a controlling owner of Rosneft.
JSC "ROSNEFTEGAZ" and BP RUSSIAN INVESTMENTS LIMITED are reported as shareholders in Rosneft per OpenSanctions.
Igor Sechin has held the role of chief executive officer (ГЛАВНЫЙ ИСПОЛНИТЕЛЬНЫЙ ДИРЕКТОР) since 2012-06-09 per OpenSanctions, and is also recorded as chief executive officer in Wikidata.
Mohammed Saleh Al Sada is reported as chairperson from 2023-07-01 per Wikidata.
OpenSanctions lists the entity as sanctioned (high confidence).
OpenSanctions lists the entity as debarred from public contracts (high confidence).
OpenSanctions lists the entity as subject to export-control restrictions (high confidence).
OpenSanctions flags the entity for trade risk (medium confidence).

11 sanctioned securities mapped to this entity are subject to sanctions and investment bans across multiple jurisdictions including Australia, Canada, the EU, the UK, and the US per OpenSanctions (high confidence).
The entity's ownership structure carries a medium-confidence signal of complex ownership layers, with three or more corporate layers identified per OpenSanctions.

Rosneft directly and ultimately consolidates Rosneft Deutschland GmbH (from 2016-02-24) per GLEIF; Rosneft Deutschland GmbH and the related entity Rosneft Deutschland are flagged as being inside a sanctioned party's ownership chain and linked to an export-controlled party per OpenSanctions.

Rosneft ultimately consolidates Общество с ограниченной ответственностью "ДИНК-ИНВЕСТ" (from 2013-03-21) and Общество с ограниченной ответственностью "РН-Капитал" (from 2017-05-11) per GLEIF; both are flagged as inside a sanctioned party's ownership chain and linked to an export-controlled party per OpenSanctions.

Multiple subsidiaries and related parties — including LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY RN KRASNODARNEFTEGAZ, NAYARA ENERGY LIMITED, OJSC SYZRAN REFINERY, JSC ACHINSK OIL REFINERY VNK, JSC KUYBYSHEVSKY OIL REFINERY, ZAO VANKORNEFT, TNK Trading International S.A., OJSC RN HOLDING, ROSNEFT FINANCE S.A., National Settlement Depository, RN-Aktiv OOO, Ruhr Oel GmbH, Nizhnevartovskaya GRES, and Rosneftegaz — are themselves flagged as sanctioned, debarred, export-controlled, or linked to sanctioned parties per OpenSanctions and OpenAleph.

Igor Sechin shares a name with a record on OpenAleph flagged as sanctioned, debarred from public contracts, and a politically exposed person; Mohammed Saleh Al Sada shares a name with a record on OpenAleph flagged as a politically exposed person — both are possible name matches only, with no birth date or nationality confirmed.
Wikirate could not be queried due to a source API schema error, so data from that source is absent.
OpenSanctions data is licensed CC-BY-NC-4.0, precluding commercial re-use of that data.
